pre_enable_validation: Replay representative Sysmon Event ID 1 data and prove detections, parent/child context, command lines, hashes, users, and event counts remain acceptable in Splunk read-back.
rollback: Disable the collector/SC4S reduction rule and replay the marker set; no reduction artifact is shipped by this profile.
notes: Only for locally approved known-good process noise; command lines and hashes are investigation-critical.

pre_enable_validation: Replay local Sysmon network data and prove destination IP/port, process, user, and suspicious egress coverage are preserved.
rollback: Disable the reduction rule and replay Event ID 3 markers.
notes: Do not suppress external egress or unusual ports by default.

pre_enable_validation: Replay DNS query markers and representative production DNS data; prove query names/results/status remain searchable for investigations.
rollback: Disable the reduction rule and replay Event ID 22 markers.
notes: Avoid dropping DNS failures, newly observed domains, or process-linked queries.

pre_enable_validation: Prove selected hash fields are redundant for local tooling and that SHA256 or equivalent remains searchable after read-back.
rollback: Restore original field preservation and replay process markers.
notes: No default field deletion; multiple hashes support correlation across tools.

pre_enable_validation: Replay representative Event ID 7 data and prove module path, signature status, hashes, process context, and suspicious load detections remain searchable.
rollback: Disable the reduction rule and replay image-load markers.
notes: Image-load telemetry is noisy but high-value for DLL search-order hijack and unsigned module investigations.

pre_enable_validation: Replay representative Event ID 10 data and prove source/target process context, granted access masks, and call traces survive read-back for injection/credential-access triage.
rollback: Disable the reduction rule and replay process-access markers.
notes: Do not suppress sensitive process targets or access masks by default.

pre_enable_validation: Replay Event ID 23 markers and representative endpoint data; prove target filenames, hashes, archived/executable flags, and process context remain searchable.
rollback: Disable the reduction rule and replay file-delete markers.
notes: Deleted files may look noisy but often support cleanup/tampering investigations.
